subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required’ if the sentence is correct as given. 

She (doesn't want to go on staring but it) was very difficult to turn her eyes away.

options.text: does wants to go on staring
didn't want to go on staring but it
do not wanted to go on staring but it

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"doesn't"** is a contraction of "**does not**" and is used to indicate the negative form of the verb** "do" **in the third person singular. (नहीं करता/करती है)

 
 
• **Example:** She** doesn't like **to eat spicy food.
 
 
 
• The phrase **"didn't want to go on staring but it"** correctly conveys **the past tense** and the **negative form of the verb. **(नहीं चाहती थी कि घूरती रहे लेकिन यह)
 
 
• **Example:** He **didn't want to go on **arguing but it was necessary to make his point clear.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the phrase** "didn't want to go on staring but it"** is the **correct replacement for the bracketed segment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: does wants to go on staring** (चाहती है कि घूरती रहे)

 
 
• **Example:** She **does want to go on staring** at the beautiful painting.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: do not wanted to go on staring but it** (नहीं चाहती थी कि घूरती रहे लेकिन यह)
 
 
• **Example:** This construction is **grammatically incorrect** as it mixes present and past tenses.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: No correction required** (कोई सुधार आवश्यक नहीं है)
 
 
• **Example:** The original sentence** is incorrect, so this option is not valid**.
 
 

 

3c:Tbdb,
The correct answer is **Option 3)**
